profileLabel: Near-neutral economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Siquijor representative with 39 principal-authored bills, mostly local development, fire code, MARINA office and barangay incentives. Authored a Siquijor special economic zone authority. Co-authored national minimum wage, an alcohol excise increase, NIRC amendments and an anti-dynasty bill.
caveat: Economic score is a mix of one authored pro-investment bill and co-authored measures. Anti-dynasty is a single coalition issue.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a special economic zone authority (+1); co-authored national minimum wage (-2) and an alcohol excise increase (-1). Three issues, mostly co-authored.
